evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `digest` still unconditionally evaluates `value['attempts'][-1]['rung']` for every `FIXED` verdict. A `FIXED` record with missing/empty `attempts` raises `KeyError`/`IndexError`, and an unexpected rung value raises `KeyError` against the fixed counts keys. The supplied harvest path accepts a verdict as fixed based only on `v['verdict'] == 'FIXED'` (lines 757–763) without validating `attempts`, so the crash path identified by the finding remains present and can abort metrics reporting. No current contract clause retires or accepts this limitation.
